title: Unique protein dynamics distinguish the highly homologous LXR alpha and beta isotypes.
authors: Roy Choudhuri, Kesaban Sankar; Okafor, C Denise
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟比较LXRα和LXRβ配体结合域的动力学差异，虽为核受体蛋白-DNA互作体系，但聚焦配体结合而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA动态研究。
abstract: The liver X receptor (LXR) is expressed as alpha and beta subtypes (NR1H3/NR1H2), which play both separate and overlapping roles in cholesterol metabolism. As ligand-regulated transcription factors, LXRalpha and LXRbeta are activated by oxysterol. The two isoforms have high percent identity, sharing nearly identical structures and binding pockets. With these similarities, it is not clear how ligands distinguish between LXRalpha and LXRbeta binding pockets. Yet, the ability to design isoform-specific modulator is highly dependent on this knowledge. Here, we test the hypothesis that, despite high structural similarity, the dynamic behavior of the receptors is distinct and can reveal fundamental differences between the isoforms. Using molecular dynamics simulations on a library of 27 oxysterols, we compare dynamic contacts, fluctuations and allosteric signaling in the ligand binding domains of both receptors. We quickly identify stability differences linked to subtle changes in secondary structure and inter-residue contacts. Using our reconstructed sequence of ancestral vertebrate LXR, we reveal that both receptors inherited distinct structural and/or dynamical features of the ancestor which underlie their dynamic differences.
abstract_zh: 肝X受体（LXR）以α和β亚型（NR1H3/NR1H2）表达，在胆固醇代谢中发挥既独立又重叠的作用。作为配体调控的转录因子，LXRα和LXRβ被氧甾醇激活。这两种亚型具有高百分比同一性，共享几乎相同的结构和结合口袋。鉴于这些相似性，尚不清楚配体如何区分LXRα和LXRβ的结合口袋。然而，设计亚型特异性调节剂的能力高度依赖于这一知识。在此，我们检验一个假设：尽管结构高度相似，受体的动态行为是不同的，并能揭示亚型之间的根本差异。通过对27种氧甾醇文库进行分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们比较了两种受体配体结合域中的动态接触、波动和变构信号。我们迅速识别出与二级结构和残基间接触的细微变化相关的稳定性差异。利用我们重建的祖先脊椎动物LXR序列，我们揭示两种受体继承了祖先的不同结构和/或动态特征，这些特征构成了其动态差异的基础。
